shared_elements: motifs stacked vertically along a central axis
abstract symbol placed above a larger rounded form
narrow rectangular/comb-like element with internal divisions
justification: Both are tall, roughly ovoid standing stones whose carved motifs are stacked one above another along a central vertical axis, and both include a prominent ring/disc form paired with curved crescent-like and scrolled elements in the middle of the field. The decisive difference is the manner of execution and framing: A is a carefully dressed slab with crisp relief, a continuous plaited border and legible figural scenes (rider, animals, ship-like forms), whereas B is an undressed boulder with shallow, weathered incisions and no border or figural narrative.
